title: Resolve single-workspace trajectory durability and SQLite safety (#1312/#1313)
intent: Implement a maintainable single-workspace solution for #1312 and #1313: retain one authoritative active trajectory per workspace with durable prior-run evidence, and provide safe Dactyl-backed SQLite coordination and diagnostics without project-level multi-run authority or unsupported automatic repair.
stop_conditions: Stop for human review if a proposed compatibility fix requires changing existing request/response schemas, silently changing validation or publication authority, bypassing the Dactyl storage boundary, or recovering a corrupted database without a supported Dactyl API.
deferred_questions: Choose the supported cross-process SQLite coordination and recovery contract through the Dactyl boundary, including locking scope, backup/restore behavior, journal-mode handling, and whether any repair may be automatic.
